Your turn: Six turns. Play one of your own cards, or spend one of three clue tokens on a teammate: A live player chooses a card to play from the clue and its observations. Rivals: A live player controls each other seat, choosing its actions from its own observations and the game history. Your cards are hidden from you; each teammate sees the other hands but not their own. A teammate chooses a free rank clue for you before each turn.
Round 6/6. Scores: [5, 5, 5].
Last resolution: Clue accepted. Clue to player 2: player 2, 2. They played slot 3: ['R', 2]; built.
